cards.title: A pipeline
cards.body: Read `|` as "then": sort the wins, then keep those over 100, then take three. Views are **lazy**: nothing is filtered until the loop pulls values.

cards.title: How to read dense code
cards.body:
- Find the data first (`wins`), then follow each step in order.
- Name intermediate results while learning: `auto big = ...` is easier than one giant expression.
- `std::greater<>{}` is a ready-made comparator meaning "a > b": the same job as a lambda.

cards.question: `wins = {500, 150, 120, 90, 300}` sorted biggest first, filter > 100, take 2. What's left?
